description: A PHYSICAL LINK BREAK REQUEST (Operator Request) from the peer brings the link to clean close; once clean, this node breaks it as Initiator with PHYSICAL LINK BREAK and declares it broken on PHYSICAL LINK BREAK CONFIRM.
note: Link setup as cas/make-called-accept: the peer's PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST (Ed4) at 2000, our PHYSICAL LINK ACCEPTED out at 52000, and the link made when that transmission ends at 57550 (B-0213, B-0400): link_state linked and cas.first_data/0.0.1.3 (B-0215). The peer is recorded Ed4 (B-0408) and the 16-bit family is in force. At 61000 the peer's DATA-ONLY (type 9, FSN 0, C_PDU START and END, both window flags set, EOT 10) carries a PHYSICAL LINK BREAK REQUEST (type 6, octets 63 00: reason 3, Operator Request, priority 0, B-0167, B-0171, B-0173), sent by normal ARQ as B-0174 and B-0312 say. It is delivered (C-0658) and owes an acknowledgement. The link is made, so the CAS acts on it (B-0244, B-0423): the link is in use and closing, so cas.first_data stops, link_state closing, and the DTS is asked for clean close with no new C_PDUs to start (B-0245, B-0246, B-0421). The link is not clean yet: the acknowledgement is owed (B-0236 (a), B-0422). At 62000 the burst ends: still not clean; csma.vdcd_end 4000, then LBT rule 1 and contention, 12000 ms; at 78000 the ACK-ONLY (type 10, RX LWE 1, no Ack Data, 15 bytes, EOT 10; too few bytes left for a copy or PADDING, so zero filled, C-1154). When that transmission ends at 83550 the link is clean (B-0237, B-0422): nothing awaits an acknowledgement either way. The CAS starts Step 1 (B-0248, B-0282, B-0316): link_state breaking and PHYSICAL LINK BREAK with reason 6, Operator request, as B-0302 maps the request's reason (B-0423), octet 46, in a type 8 D_PDU (B-0160). The MAC follows its own transmission with the VDCD LBT wait, 3000 (K-0074), then contention, 45000 ms; out at 131550, our C_PDU ID 1. When that transmission ends at 137100, cas.break/0.0.1.3 starts with cas.break_timeout_ms, 60000 (B-0283, B-0400, C-1100, B-0424). At 141000 the peer's PHYSICAL LINK BREAK CONFIRM (octet 50, its C_PDU ID 1): the Initiator declares the link broken (B-0166, B-0286): cas.break stops, link_state unlinked, D_CONNECTION_TERMINATED to the DTS (C-0652) and C_PHYSICAL_LINK_BROKEN to the SIS. Nothing is queued, so the burst end starts nothing. Sizes: a DATA-ONLY is 19 bytes plus its segment, an ACK-ONLY 15 bytes plus its Ack Data. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500): 10, 20, 30 for 1, 2, 3 blocks to go (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node) and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133). A CAS-1 C_PDU of one octet in a type 8 D_PDU fills a block exactly (25 bytes; EOT and reception window 10), C_PDU IDs from 0 in each node's own sequence (C-1040), EOW 0. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4, 15: contention waits 45000, 12000, 45000 ms (K-0080).
